headword: {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}
gloss: transfer guide; route guide; transit-routing app

definitions.gloss: transfer guide; transit-routing service; train route finder
definitions.explanation: Information showing how to transfer between trains, subways, or buses to get from one station to another. Also the generic name for smartphone apps and web services (notably 'Yahoo!{乗換案内|のりかえあんない}') that calculate such routes.

examples.japanese: {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}を{調|しら}べた。
アプリの{乗換案内|のりかえあんない}が{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: The transit-routing app is very handy.

examples.japanese: {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}で{調|しら}べたら、{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}で{急行|きゅうこう}に{乗|の}り{換|か}えるのが{早|はや}いとわかった。
examples.english: When I checked the route finder, I learned that transferring to the express at the next station is fastest.

notes:
Compound of {乗|の}り{換|か}え (transfer between trains/lines) + {案内|あんない} (guide, information). Originally referred to printed timetables and station signs, but in everyday speech today it most often refers to a smartphone app or website.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}を{調|しら}べる: to look up a transfer route
- {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}アプリ: transit-routing app
- {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}{所|じょ}: information desk for transfers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乗|の}り{換|か}え: transfer (the act of changing trains/lines)
- {時刻表|じこくひょう}: timetable
- {経路|けいろ}{検索|けんさく}: route search (more technical term for the same feature)
